_meta.notes: Root Sight two-mode camera, soil cutaway, and reroot substrate multiplier

cutaway_radius.notes: Radius of the underground cutaway sphere around the camera target

aperture_radius_ratio.notes: Radius of the circular hole in the ground as a fraction of cutaway_radius; the cavity bowl's mouth reads the same number

aperture_min_m.notes: Floor for the aperture radius in metres, so a seedling's cavity still reaches daylight

transition_ms.notes: Smooth transition duration between surface and underground modes (0 = instant)

soil_opacity.notes: Opacity of soil inside the cutaway (0 = invisible, 0.9 = nearly opaque)

own_root_highlight_color.notes: High-contrast color for the viewer's own roots

rival_root_highlight_color.notes: Distinct color for nearby rival roots

substrate_multiplier.notes: Movement multiplier for uprooted reroot crawl (T06); applies whether Root Sight is on or off

camera_target.notes: Default cutaway target reference; the camera is an independent entity

max_cavity_bubbles.notes: Bubbles uploaded to the soil and plant shaders. Nearby roots are clustered to fit this budget.

bubble_merge_cell_m.notes: Grid cell used to merge nearby root nodes into one cavity bubble.

bubble_padding_m.notes: Clearance added around each root bubble so bark is not clipped by the soil wall.

rival_bubble_budget.notes: Bubbles reserved for rival plants after the player's own roots are placed.

camera_burrow_enabled.notes: Allow the eye to travel below the surface while Root Sight is open.

max_burrow_depth_m.notes: Deepest the Root Sight camera may descend below the local surface.

cavity_clearance_m.notes: Distance the camera keeps from the cavity wall while burrowing.

rebuild_hz.notes: How often the cavity bubble set is rebuilt from root data.

min_extent_m.notes: Smallest underground extent reported for a plant, metres. Below this there is nothing to size a cavity from.

surface_progress.notes: Below this transition progress the plant is treated as still on the surface and the configured radius is reported unchanged.

min_cutaway_radius_m.notes: Smallest cutaway radius, metres, so a newly germinated seed still opens a usable view.

extent_to_radius.notes: The pit is this many root-extents wide. The bowl mouth is 70% of this radius, so the factor leaves room for the full root spread.

auto_open_on_root_growth.notes: Open Root Sight by itself the moment a buried part starts growing, so a player who grows a root sees the ground open instead of having to know about R. It fires once per new buried part, so a hand-close (R) still stands until the next one starts.

eye_window_radius_m.notes: Radius of the air bubble cut around a buried camera, metres. Root Sight is a hole seen from above, but the camera can fly down into the cavity; the eye then sits inside the soil skin and saw a wall of dirt with no roots behind it. This window keeps air around the eye and fuses with the root bubbles, so a tunnel to the cavity stays open wherever the camera is. Zero disables it and leaves the soil intact around the eye.

cavity_topsoil_color.notes: Dug wall, top stratum: dark root-woven humus at the lip. The pit is a cut through a body, and three earths read as three layers where three browns read as one brown.

cavity_subsoil_color.notes: Dug wall, middle stratum: warm ochre subsoil.

cavity_deep_color.notes: Dug wall, deepest stratum: cold pale earth above the floor. Pale on purpose - a near-black grey vanished after dark and the third layer read as shadow.

cavity_night_fill.notes: Fraction of the dug wall's own albedo that survives at midnight. A pit is lit by the sky above its mouth, and the sky does not go out; at 0.22 the strata were there and could not be seen.

cavity_day_fill.notes: The same fraction at full daylight: a floor under the wall's lit value, so shade keeps its edges while the wall never goes black.
